changes.note: Minimum required Ruby version raised from 3.0 to 3.2 because Ruby 3.0 and 3.1 reached End of Life. Not a code change: the runtime must be upgraded before the library can be.

Removed. Used for session persistence when the library handled session storage; after storage was deprecated in v12.3.0 applications became responsible for their own persistence. Callers must store individual session attributes instead.

Removed due to a security vulnerability: it called Oj.load without safe mode, allowing instantiation of arbitrary Ruby objects. Callers must reconstruct sessions with Session.new() from individually stored attributes.
